answer: Persistent Presence Ledger. Each identity must hold a continuously open session whose idle bandwidth and compute draw are metered like slow water through karst; gaps reset the ledger. Only identities with unbroken ledger history may transact, so a sybil farm must sustain thousands of live sessions. That sustained attention costs real capacity—the ocean of parallel sessions an attacker needs grows linearly, and each cedar-fresh identity requires its own paid channel.
